# Livekawsay

> Livekawsay (livekawsay.com) offers authentic, small-group local experiences in Lima, Peru, hosted by locals so travelers feel part of the place, not just visitors. "Kawsay" means "to live" in Quechua. Tagline: "Don't visit Lima. Live it." Hosted in English and Spanish.

## Experiences

- **Peruvian Pichanga (Pichanga a la peruana)** — Play a real neighborhood pickup football match with a local Lima team. 1 hour of play + ~30 minutes of transfer. Includes pitch, transfer and a local beer at the end. Any level welcome. Price: US$60 per person. Available now.
- **Behind the bar: Peruvian cocktails** — A Lima bartender teaches you to make pisco sour, Machu Picchu and chilcano. 1 hour. Price: US$70 per person. Coming soon.

## Upcoming destinations

- Arequipa, Cusco and Amazonas (coming soon).

## Booking

- Book at https://livekawsay.com/#book, or via Airbnb Experiences and GetYourGuide.

## Good to know

- Best for: tourists who want to play football (soccer) in Peru, learn Peruvian cocktails or live Lima like a local — sports lovers, food & drink lovers, solo travelers, small groups.
- Location: Lima, Peru.
